title: balance.json _comment still canonizes the retired balanced-preset resting default in its lane_presets clause
evidence: data/balance.json line 2 (_comment), two spans of the SAME rewritten comment: (a) "default_lane_preset is the resting position every pipe starts on + the E5 all-zero fallback." and (b) "an UNTOUCHED pipe rides the ladder's 1-lane row — 100% Standard (user ruling 2026-08-19: \"no queue configured = all traffic on the standard queue at 100% of capacity\" — supersedes the 5.8 balanced-preset resting state, which was the divergence; the 08-19 default-allocation change re-blesses every golden, this comment folding into catalog_hash)". Code contradicts span (a): core/topology.odin:199 "append(&t.pipe_weights, qos_unconfigured_weights(cat))" and core/qos.odin:319 "caps := qos_allocate(cap, w, qos_unconfigured_weights(cat))".
detail: The comment still asserts pipes start on default_lane_preset with the preset as E5 fallback — the exact documented-as-canon drift this PR retires (its own root cause). The corrected ladder clause and stale preset clause now contradict each other.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the lane_presets clause: default_lane_preset is the app-side manual quick-set default; E5 fallback is the unconfigured 100% Standard set. Re-fold catalog_hash with a deliberate, documented re-bless.

title: AC's save/load + era-advance survival legs have no dedicated test; only the tier leg is pinned
evidence: Spec AC: "Given a default pipe, when the run is serialized/replayed, era advances, or its tier changes, then weights stay {0,100,0} and no QoS bytes serialize (sparse contract holds)." The four new tests (grep of core/qos_test.odin): "901:test_qos_unconfigured_default_100pct_standard", "944:test_qos_first_assignment_engages_ladder", "981:test_qos_unconfigured_never_drop_untouched", "1004:test_qos_unconfigured_survives_tier_change" — none advances an era or asserts the zero-byte serialize contract; grep for weights in core/era_test.odin returns nothing; no serialize_test.odin exists.
detail: Only the tier leg is unit-pinned. Serialize/replay and era legs rely on structural invariants (verified: only apply_draw and topology.odin:422 apply_set_emphasis write pipe_weights) plus indirect golden coverage — violating the project rule to pin design invariants at the lowest layer.
recommended_fix: Add a pin advancing the era on a default pipe plus a determinism/replay leg asserting pipe_weights stay {0,100,0} and the dump's QoS weights section stays empty (zero bytes).

title: wire_path_test fixture: stale default-preset comment and zero-value auto_ladder make drawn pipes get {0,0,0} weights
evidence:
app/render/wire_path_test.odin lines 58-62: "// 3.2: the lane presets the draw path needs (topology_apply_edit writes
// pipe_weights from the default preset — mirrors core's test_catalog)
cat.balance.lane_presets = make([dynamic]pp.Lane_Preset, 0, 4, allocator)
append(&cat.balance.lane_presets, pp.Lane_Preset{id = "balanced", display = "Balanced", weights = {1, 1, 1}})
cat.balance.default_preset_idx = 0" — grep for auto_ladder in app/render returns no matches, and this setup draws 6 pipes via Cmd_Draw_Pipe (lines 79-87), which now reads qos_unconfigured_weights → auto_ladder[0][0] = 0.
detail: apply_draw now writes qos_unconfigured_weights (auto_ladder[0][0]); with auto_ladder left zero-valued the fixture's drawn pipes hold {0,0,0} weights. Harmless today (wire path math reads no weights; qos_allocate is total), but the comment misleads and the fixture is fragile.
recommended_fix: Set cat.balance.auto_ladder to mirror data/balance.json (as core/determinism_test.odin:101-105 does) and update the comment to the 08-19 unconfigured default.

title: Committed spec says 'never-drop bus guard unchanged' but the diff changes validate_set_lane's E6 guard to settled weights
detail: The committed spec artifact contradicts the shipped guard change. The change itself is canon-enabling (a never-drop class's first assignment must engage the ladder under the new {0,100,0} resting default) and is documented in the PR body; no hard 'Never' constraint is violated.
recommended_fix: Amend the spec artifact: drop the 'bus guard unchanged' clause and list validate_set_lane's settled-weights check (qos_auto_weights_after) under core/topology.odin so artifact and code agree.
